answer: Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mirror of the next round. What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
